'''Hetter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who as an Ensign onboard the ''[[Black Talon]]'' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent Sith Empire.
